title: Apogee: bolder, more space
question: Bolder hand, steered toward space. The deal leads with Uppskjutningstavlan; Stjärnatlas beat it on both axes. Pick, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Uppskjutningstavlan
options.lineage: Split-flap departure boards, translated into a launch site's board
options.thesis: Each Projekt's hill is a launch trajectory lit lamp by lamp up to the apogee, and the Scopes sit on a split-flap board below.
materials: black flap faces, white condensed letters
options.viewport: Steel nav rail of Funktionsområden; a lamp-matrix trajectory board with Scopes as lit squares (amber uphill → white at the apogee → green done); under it a split-flap table: Scope, Ägare, Läge, status (UPPFÖR, NEDFÖR, STILLA 21D in amber).
options.risk: The space is in the trajectory and name, not a sky; on a phone the flap cells must collapse to plain rows.

raised.raise: Each Funktionsområde gets its own full-strength hue on its rail tab.
The selected Scope's Läge shows at monumental scale.
Every board panel is ruled in 1px hairlines with registration crosshairs at its corners.
Each Scope keeps fixed personal furniture: name, Ägare, Läge, days at Läge, always in the same cells.

options.label: Stjärnatlas
options.lineage: Celestial star atlases read under a red flashlight
options.thesis: Each Projekt is a chart of the night sky: Scopes are stars on a graduated coordinate grid, their colour the star's spectral colour, their brightness how recently they moved.
materials: deep navy chart with a faint star field
italic serif star names, red-flashlight rings and annotations
options.viewport: Top bar of Funktionsområden; left, the Funktionsområde's Projekt as mini sky charts; centre, the Projekt's hill as a dashed orbit through the stars (orange-red uphill → pale gold crest → blue-white done), the selected Scope under a red reticle, a stuck one ringed in red with 'Ingen rörelse på 21 dagar'; right, an object index of Scopes.
options.case: Wins audience (it is the space you asked for, and keeps Solbana's arc and Pulsar's overview of every Projekt) and clarity (dots on a hill, read at a glance).
options.risk: Dark ground: needs a careful light variant for Notion embeds and bright meeting rooms.

options.label: Acetate manual
options.thesis: Hued tab boards under clear acetate leaves.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.risk: The cute look you ruled out.

options.label: Terminal wayfinding
options.kept: Monumental numerals for the selected Läge.
